notes: v11.1 / display V5.1 (2026-10-14, per Stephen) — TEMPLATE-ONLY; build_data.py byte-identical to v10/v11 (f1930509…). THIS MONTH = THE CALENDAR MONTH (map §12X). inMon() was 'everything since the last saved close in month_closes.json' (d > MOPEN); with the Aug and Sep closes archived but never closed into that file, MOPEN sat at 07-31 and every month-scoped surface — warehouse to-dos (monUnexpItems), truck cycle-count tolerance (truckAdjState / truckAdjItems), scratch & dent (sdItems), job flags (monJobFlags), the answered oval (meScore), Equipment consumed vs sold — silently carried Aug 1 → today. Measured on the 2026-10-14 live build: all 7 open warehouse to-dos were Aug/Sep items, 17 of the 33 'October' truck adjustments were Aug/Sep, $33,214 'adjusted in October' was really $18,470. Now: MON0 = CURMON-01, inMon(d) = d >= MON0 && d <= maxDay; month-scoped builders take an optional month (inMonOf); the truck tolerance state is cached per month (_TA[mon]); the roll-up key stays truckroll|<mon>|<veh>. The position-table ROLL-FORWARD still runs from the prior SAVED close (MOPEN, open-exclusive) because that is what it reconciles against, and renders a warning (#meStale) when that close is older than last month (STALE_CLOSE / MISSING_CLOSES). NEW: prior-month carry-over line (.carryover) under both to-do bands — per prior month the ledger covers (LEDGER_MONS), how many items are still unanswered on that month's saved copy, with the archive link; informational, never a card, never scored. Saved-copies list shows a LIVE 'n still unanswered' / 'nothing open' pill for months the ledger covers. Month Position export sheet states the scope and the stale-close note. Rev badge V5.1.
